## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      5 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 24, 2026 - Aug 24, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _George Ristic_, Aug 24, 2026, 1/5: "Latest update turned the app into unusable UI mess. I uninstalled the app and decided never to buy Galaxy watch or phone ever again. Switching to Garmin for proper fitness tracking rather than having the "fitness" hardware and software developed by the team of overweight people who never ran more than 100m in their life. Goodbye Samsung, you deserve to be devoured by Chinese phone manufacturers."
            2. _JWM B_, Jul 24, 2026, 1/5: "Terrible update, completely ruined the app. Since the latest Samsung Health update, this app has gone downhill fast. The new UI is cluttered and confusing, and honestly feels like a step backward instead of an improvement. Worse, the app crashes constantly, which makes my Samsung Watch practically useless for sports and training. I rely on this thing for tracking workouts, and now I can't trust it to even stay open. This is three steps back, not progress. Really disappointing!"
            3. _Holly_, Aug 24, 2026, 2/5: "Keeps telling me my data hasn't synced in 3 days, then doesn't load the "Sync with Samsung Cloud" option so I can't see what the issue is or do anything to fix it. Seems like a bug. Also feels like it's trying to push some new feature on me everytime I go into the app. All I want is steps, heart rate, sleep and workouts, but there's always some random pop up which you can't just x out of."
<!--/ir-theme-->
